Summary: The 2WikiMultihopQA original paper reports baseline BiDAF++ models achieving 59% F1 (answer) on the distractor setting, with joint F1 ∼41%; fullwiki is substantially harder (∼34% F1) (Yang et al., 2018). The latest results show the SOTA model achieving 80.79 F1 on the HotpotQA test set (Gemini-2.5-Flash, Jul 7, 2026) and 75.9 Answer F1 on the HotpotQA fullwiki setting (test) (Jun 11, 2026). The dataset construction emphasizes exact match and F1 scores for answer prediction, supporting facts prediction, and evidence generation, with joint metrics combining individual task performances to assess overall reasoning capability (alphaXiv, 2020).
